title: Rooftop Laundry Gusts
setting: A city rooftop is strung with laundry, water tanks, vents, and gusty gaps between buildings.
food: lint → clothespins → shirts → water tanks
interaction: Crosswinds pull sheets along cables; the goo catches one, tugging a row of pins loose and feeding them into a corner.
jumps: A lifted sheet reveals a lower roof section.
risk: Cable collisions and cloth animation can dominate a small scene.

title: Wind Farm Service Deck
setting: A high service deck sits among broad turbines, maintenance crates, seed pods, and cloud gaps.
food: dust flecks → bolts → crates → turbine bases
interaction: Rotor wash nudges loose crates in circles; the goo blocks a blade gap and rolls the crates into a feeding lane.
risk: Large rotating blades can obscure the goo and complicate collision tuning.

title: Balloon Parade Over Market
setting: A floating market hangs below a parade of hot-air balloons, basket ropes, awnings, and cargo tags.
food: paper scraps → basket handles → cargo baskets → balloon envelopes
interaction: Balloons tug crossing ropes; the goo pins a rope bundle, lowering baskets into a slow row of edible tags.
jumps: A lowered basket reveals a second market awning.
risk: Rope tangles need simple proxies or the scene becomes hard to read.

title: Treetop Cloudbridge
setting: Treetop islands rise through fog, joined by rope bridges and covered with broad leaves and seed pods.
food: pollen → seed pods → branch clusters → tree crowns
interaction: A gust sways the bridge; the goo settles on it, shaking pods onto lower branches where they roll together.
risk: Canopy layers can hide edible pods beneath the overhead camera.

title: Rooftop Rain Garden
setting: A sloped rooftop has gutters, rain barrels, puddles, vents, and trays of wind-bent plants.
food: raindrops → leaves → barrel lids → roof gardens
interaction: Water follows gutters downhill; the goo plugs one channel, swelling a coherent puddle that spills onto the next tray.
jumps: The backed-up puddle uncovers a barrel behind a vent.
risk: Local puddle removal needs a convincing surface boundary on the roof.

title: Marsh Flock Crossing
setting: A marsh lies far below a broad sky lane, with migrating geese, feather clumps, kites, and cloud puffs.
food: feathers → small birds → flock leaders → cloud puffs
interaction: The flock follows its lead bird; the goo drifts into the formation, bunching birds into a slow spiral that sheds feathers.
risk: A moving flock needs restrained counts and clear silhouettes to avoid visual noise.

title: Wind Tunnel Over Canyon

food: dust motes → fabric scraps → gliders → cable towers
interaction: An updraft lifts gliders around the canyon; the goo blocks one current and makes them circle a nearby feeder pocket.
jumps: The redirected gliders reveal a sheltered ledge below.
risk: Updraft volumes need broad, predictable boundaries so the player can recover.

title: Sky Freight Crossing
setting: Suspended freight docks connect airship routes with cargo parcels, cable reels, and swinging loading cranes.
food: paper tags → parcel straps → cargo boxes → airship hulls
interaction: Crates swing from crossing cables; the goo catches a line, pulling several parcels into a gentle chain toward the dock.
risk: Swinging cargo requires forgiving joints and broad collision shapes.

title: Thunderhead Rain Shelf

food: mist wisps → rain beads → cloud shelves → storm caps
interaction: Updrafts funnel mist into rotating cells; the goo mops a cell edge, making the remaining cloud drift toward the opening.
risk: Translucent cloud volumes need strong outlines to keep local removal legible.

jumps: A crowded cable reveals the upper station.

title: Dark Halo Shadow Hills
setting: A dim galactic disc sits inside tracer beads rolling over invisible gravity hills and broad shadow passes.
food: tracer specks → halo beads → star clumps → disc rim
interaction: Gravity-inspired slopes bend tracer paths; the goo blocks a low pass and sends beads over a neighboring hill.
jumps: A shifted tracer stream reveals the disc rim.
risk: Contour ribbons are needed to show otherwise invisible slopes.

title: Quasar Jet Warehouse
setting: A bright galactic nucleus sends twin jets through a warehouse of gas cargo pods, star clumps, and lobe shelves.
food: gas flecks → cargo pods → star clumps → jet collars
interaction: The jets push pods down opposite aisles; the goo bridges one aisle and spills its cargo into the other.
risk: Twin currents must feel gentle and collectible.

title: Galactic Fountain Terraces
setting: A galaxy disc sends gas columns into a halo of return droplets, landing shelves, and feeder terraces.
food: gas droplets → halo beads → returning clumps → fountain roots
interaction: Rising columns lift droplets and returning arcs drop them elsewhere; the goo nudges a root and moves the landing pile.
jumps: The shifted landing pile reveals a higher terrace.
risk: Vertical motion needs shadows and scale cues from above.

title: Radio Lobe Bubbleworks
setting: Twin radio lobes form purple bubbleworks filled with pressure bubbles, gas beads, dust knots, and a central bridge.
food: gas wisps → pressure bubbles → dust knots → lobe walls
interaction: Bubble pressure pushes beads toward each rim; the goo mops one cluster and the remaining bubbles expand into its space.
risk: Bubble expansion needs visible contact boundaries.

title: Galaxy Group Caravanserai
setting: A galaxy group forms a caravanserai of moving galaxy islands, cluster beads, crossing lanes, and shared dust pools.
food: dust → galaxy beads → group clumps → cluster rim
interaction: Neighboring gravity lanes exchange galaxy beads; the goo blocks one crossing and makes a stream circle a dust pool.
jumps: The circling stream reveals a quiet inner lane.
risk: Several galaxy silhouettes need enough separation for steering.

title: Globular Cluster Pinwheel
setting: A dense globular cluster turns like a pinwheel of star balls, dust pockets, orbit lanes, and central gaps.
food: dust motes → star beads → star balls → cluster core
interaction: Close lanes bump star balls outward; the goo parks in a gap, redirecting them toward a slower inner lane.
risk: High object density can hide the goo at lane crossings.

title: Void Island Ferry
setting: A sparse void has isolated galaxy islands, drifting intergalactic clumps, faint lanes, and a broad empty ferry route.
food: dust → gas clumps → galaxy beads → island rims
interaction: Gravity lanes pull clumps between islands; the goo pushes one off-lane, sweeping a fresh arc of dust.
risk: Sparse scenery needs distinct islands and route landmarks.

title: Galactic Ring Reservoir
setting: An outer galactic ring contains feeder gaps, star clumps, dust reservoirs, and slow shepherd clusters.
food: dust grains → star beads → reservoir clumps → ring arcs
interaction: Shepherd clusters herd clumps around the ring; the goo blocks a gap and diverts the herd into a side reservoir.
jumps: The filled reservoir reveals a gap behind its rim.
risk: A closed ring can feel like a track without alternate gaps.

title: Amoeba Galaxy Picnic
setting: A giant amoeba drifts through galaxy crumbs, star sprinkles, supercluster plates, and a quiet blacktile void.
food: star sprinkles → galaxy crumbs → cluster plates → amoeba shell
interaction: The amoeba's sticky wake carries crumbs in a broad loop; the goo follows the spill and gathers it against a plate.
risk: The giant amoeba must read as a moving object, not a combatant.

title: Stellar Graveyard Carousel
setting: A dim galactic graveyard has white-dwarf chunks, neutron beads, dust drifts, and slow remnant lanes.
food: dust flecks → dwarf chunks → neutron beads → graveyard shelves
interaction: Dense remnants tug dust into paired loops; the goo wedges between two and redirects their shared wake.
jumps: The redirected wake reveals a dormant remnant lane.
risk: A dark palette needs bright outlines for small food.

title: Cosmic Weather Radar
setting: A galactic weather station maps charged grains along magnetic arcs between star islands, radar dishes, and cloud banks.
food: charged specks → ray beads → star islands → magnetic arches
interaction: Field arcs carry grains in loops; the goo crosses an arc and transfers the stream into a neighboring sweep.
risk: Arc crossings need height or line cues to stay distinct.

title: Folded Map Market
setting: A translucent spacetime map folds over a market of matter beads, landmark stalls, and bright crease crossings.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → landmark stalls → map fabric
interaction: Crossing a crease moves the goo to a distant stall; mopping one fold pulls its two market edges apart.
jumps: The crease opens to reveal a second market row.
risk: Crease exits need unmistakable paired landmarks.

title: Causal Domino Avenue
setting: A causal avenue is lined with translucent slabs, matter beads, and upright event tiles that lean toward a far plaza.
food: spark motes → matter beads → event tiles → avenue slabs
interaction: Pushing one tile sends a visible wake into the next; the goo parks across the chain and collects the displaced beads.
risk: The chain must stay readable without becoming a timing challenge.

title: Elastic Trampoline Universe
setting: A broad elastic sheet stretches between star knots, with bead pockets, slack edges, and a central bounce basin.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → pocket knots → sheet fabric
interaction: The sheet rebounds under moving beads; the goo settles on a crest, sending nearby beads into a new pocket.
jumps: A sagging corner reveals a quiet underside.
risk: Mesh deformation needs a simple stable implementation.

title: Wormhole Pantry
setting: Two wormhole mouths open in a soft spacetime pantry of shelves, matter crates, orbiting knots, and folded floor.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → pantry crates → mouth rims
interaction: A pushed crate enters one mouth and emerges from the other; mopping a rim makes the paired exit wobble and spill beads.
risk: Paired transfers need consistent entry and exit feedback.

title: Event Horizon Carousel
setting: A black circular horizon forms a carousel of orbit rails, stretched matter beads, foam seats, and a calm central well.
food: foam bubbles → stretched beads → orbit rails → horizon membrane
interaction: Matter slides around the horizon and grows tails; the goo mops one rim section, leaving the remaining foam recoiling inward.
jumps: A cleared rim reveals the well's quiet inner ring.
risk: The central well must remain traversable and non-harmful.

title: Delayed Echo Warehouse
setting: A translucent warehouse stores matter crates beside mirrored motion trails, echo lanes, and causal loading banks.
food: spark flecks → matter crates → trail knots → warehouse banks
interaction: Each pushed crate leaves a world-made echo that repeats its route later; the goo collects the original and echo as paths meet.
risk: Echo trails need distinct tint and short readable routes.

title: Block-Universe Staircase
setting: Stacked translucent slabs represent adjacent moments, each carrying matter beads, footprints, and ramps between levels.
food: spark motes → matter beads → slab chunks → stair landings
interaction: A bead pushed on one slab appears farther along the matching ramp; the goo crosses slabs and gathers both positions.
jumps: The highest slab reveals a bright empty step.
risk: Height shading must separate overlap from duplication.

title: Light-Cone Canal Locks
setting: Angled translucent canals carry glowing beads through a spacetime basin with widening mouths, banks, and gentle one-way bends.
food: light motes → matter beads → canal knots → canal walls
interaction: Each canal carries objects toward its widening mouth; the goo pushes a bank and diverts the stream into a neighboring outlet.
risk: Persistent direction cues prevent the flow becoming opaque.

title: Geodesic Bowl Orchard
setting: A curved spacetime bowl slopes toward a central mass, with orbiting matter fruit, ridged paths, and low shelves.
food: spark grains → matter beads → orbit fruit → bowl shelves
interaction: Objects roll along curved paths around the mass; the goo sits on a ridge and reroutes fruit into a slower orbit.
jumps: The slower orbit reveals a lower bowl shelf.
risk: Steep slopes need smooth goo contact and forgiving steering.

title: Expanding Metric Picnic Blanket
setting: An elastic spacetime blanket stretches between fixed star knots, carrying bead baskets, loose crumbs, and widening lanes.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → bead baskets → blanket fabric
interaction: The fabric expands beneath objects and separates them; the goo anchors beside a knot, bunching baskets against its edge.
risk: Expansion must read as world motion without a countdown.

title: Contracting Metric Funnel
setting: A soft spacetime basin contracts toward a bright center, carrying matter beads past flexible banks and folded shelves.
food: spark motes → matter beads → bank knots → basin fabric
interaction: The shrinking surface pulls beads inward; the goo presses on a bank and curls the incoming stream around its body.
jumps: A parted bank reveals a slower outer basin.
risk: The center needs a bounded floor so objects stay playable.

title: Mobius Parcel Loop
setting: A one-sided spacetime band twists through parcel stalls, matter beads, landmark posts, and an upside-down return lane.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → parcel knots → band shelves
interaction: Objects crossing the twist return from the opposite side; mopping a segment shortens the loop and shifts its exit.
risk: Landmarks must remain recognizable after the twist.

title: Causal Diamond Nursery
setting: Overlapping causal diamonds hold paired matter beads, sloped floors, corner knots, and a broad central nursery.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → corner knots → diamond walls
interaction: Pushing one bead toward a corner sends its paired bead opposite; the goo blocks a diagonal and gathers both paths.
jumps: A cleared diagonal reveals the nursery's far corner.
risk: Paired motion needs visible links to show cause and effect.

title: Gravitational Wave Sheet
setting: A thin spacetime sheet carries broad traveling ripples, matter beads, flexible anchors, and quiet troughs.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → ripple knots → sheet anchors
interaction: A ripple lifts beads along its crest; the goo settles across the crest and leaves the beads in a new trough.
risk: A traveling mesh wave must remain stable and affordable.

title: Quantum Foam Ferry Pier
setting: A dark spacetime shore has paired foam holes, glowing matter beads, soft rims, and a ferry-like shortcut.
food: spark bubbles → matter beads → foam knots → hole rims
interaction: A bubble opens a shortcut to its paired hole; the goo mops one rim and the partner spills beads onto shore.
jumps: The paired hole reveals a second shore pocket.
risk: Pairing must be explicit so shortcuts feel causal.

title: Branching Timeline Orchard
setting: A translucent timeline orchard has branching limbs, repeated matter fruit, shared roots, and clear fork spaces.
food: spark flecks → matter fruit → branch knots → timeline limbs
interaction: Fruit crossing a fork leaves matching fruit on both limbs; the goo mops one limb and the remaining branch pulls them together.
risk: Repeated objects need subtle differences between branches.

title: Singularity Funnel
setting: An elastic funnel narrows toward a dark point, with spiral matter streams, raised fabric banks, and outer shelves.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → stream clumps → funnel banks
interaction: Spiral streams carry clumps inward; the goo blocks an outer bank and peels one stream into a slower spiral.
jumps: The slower spiral reveals a wide outer shelf.
risk: A bounded center must preserve control at the narrow end.

title: Metric Seam Quilt
setting: A continuous spacetime cloth has stitched seams that bend headings, with matter beads, slack folds, and loose hems.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → seam knots → cloth folds
interaction: Crossing a seam turns an object's travel direction; the goo pushes a seam knot and redirects a bead stream.
risk: Seams need visible heading shifts to feel causal.

title: Universe Horizon Umbrella
setting: A curved translucent horizon arches like an umbrella above star beads, rim knots, elastic ribs, and a quiet void.
food: spark motes → star beads → horizon knots → dome fabric
interaction: Expansion slides rim beads inward along the ribs; the goo braces on a fold and gathers them as paths curve.
jumps: Eating a rib reveals the starry void below.
risk: The dome needs depth cues without shrinking edible targets.

title: Tablecloth of Everything
setting: A translucent tablecloth spans a void, with stitched folds, star knots, causal currents, and a loose edible hem.
food: spark crumbs → star beads → stitched hems → spacetime fabric
interaction: Currents tug knots along folds; the goo mops each contacted section, and the remaining cloth draws together until regions disappear.
jumps: Eating the hem reveals the void beneath.
risk: The finale needs a readable local-consumption shader and a bounded end state.
